experience.reason: The sudden, jarring shift into visceral body horror and the introduction of specific, unexplained proper nouns (Leoran, Ertree) breaks the established metaphysical intimacy, confusing the thematic focus on internal grief with disjointed lore.

The sudden shift to visceral, biological horror ("four small lights press against my ribs") feels tonally dissonant with the preceding abstract metaphysical dialogue, breaking the established mood of psychological dread without sufficient narrative grounding.
